messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor follow-up: we need evidence that RBAC changes deployed during the 2024-11-10 maintenance window were scoped correctly and that any ephemeral KMS keys used during rolling restarts were rotated and recorded. Can you provide a short provenance bundle + locations?

sam_b: hey @auditor_jane, thanks — we'll pull the deployment timeline + RBAC diffs. quick Q: do you need the full git commit + CI run or just the microservice RBAC delta + k8s rolebindings? :thinking_face:

auditor_jane: short is fine but it must show who approved the change, the concrete diffs applied, and evidence of the KMS key lifecycle for any ephemeral keys created. auditor prefers signed attestations or an audit log export.

anu_sec: ack. We have three pieces: 1) git PR + approval thread id, 2) k8s audit logs showing RoleBinding apply events, 3) KMS CloudTrail/Syslog entries for key creation/rotation. Will bundle a CSV manifest linking artifacts.

luis_ops: also adding the automated deploy bot trace (deploy-bot#424) which includes the rollout window and exact node list. Example snippet: 
```
deploy-bot: rollout start 2024-11-10T02:00:01Z
service: auth-mgr
image: ghcr.io/redwood/auth-mgr@sha256:abcd1234
k8s: rolebinding apply id=rb-2024-11010-7f
nodes: [gke-redwood-prod-3a, gke-redwood-prod-3b]
rollout-status: successful
```

sam_b: For KMS, ephemeral keys are issued by our key broker service (kb-service). Logs live in s3://redwood-audit/kms/2024/11/10/ and we capture envelope key IDs in CloudTrail. Example CloudTrail line: `CreateKey: KeyId=ephemeral-20241110-9f3a, Principal=kb-service@infra.redwood, RequestTime=2024-11-10T02:01:12Z`

anu_sec: Important: we rotate ephemeral keys on teardown. We'll export CloudTrail entries and a signed manifest from our KMS operator cert (CN=redwood-kms-operator) to prove rotation. The manifest will include KeyId, creation_ts, rotation_ts, destruction_ts (if applicable), and requestor principal.

auditor_jane: That sounds good. Also need sampling rationale — auditor wants to understand how you chose which logs to include (we can't ship terabytes). Provide a deterministic sampling plan (by request ID range or time window).

sam_b: We'll provide a sampling manifest: window 2024-11-10T01:55:00Z — 2024-11-10T03:05:00Z, include all deploy-related RequestIDs (prefix dep-*) and any KMS events with KeyId prefix ephemeral-20241110. We'll also include checksums (sha256) for each exported file.

luis_ops: We'll prepare presigned S3 links for the bundle, plus a short playbook to recreate the export commands. Example export command we used: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/kms/2024/11/10/000001.json.gz ./ && sha256sum 000001.json.gz`

anu_sec: For RBAC diffs: we will include `git show` of the PR merge commit, plus `kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml` snapshots taken right after the rollout. We'll annotate each RoleBinding with a screenshot of the approval thread in GitHub (PR #8421).

sam_b: One caveat — some RoleBindings are autogenerated by our infra-controller and have transient annotations. We'll strip non-provenance annotations and include a note in the manifest about automated annotation normalization.

auditor_jane: OK please call out any privacy-sensitive data and redact it beforehand. Also, I need a signed attestation from your security lead that the bundle is complete for that window. A PGP-signed note is fine.

anu_sec: We'll produce: 1) tar.gz bundle with manifest.csv + sha256 sums, 2) CloudTrail slice for the window, 3) deploy-bot trace, 4) PR/approval screenshots, 5) signed attestation (pgp). We'll mark redacted fields with [REDACTED] and include a redaction log.

luis_ops: I'm going to start the export now and post presigned links when ready. ETA ~25m.

incident-bot: incident:export_job_992 queued (owner: luis_ops) — status: queued — ETA: 25m

sam_b: In parallel, I'm attaching a short query used to pull RoleBinding apply events from our k8s-audit index: `index=k8s-audit event=apply object.kind=RoleBinding | where time >= "2024-11-10T01:55:00Z" and time <= "2024-11-10T03:05:00Z" | table time, request_id, user, object_name, namespace`

auditor_jane: Thanks — once you share the presigned links I will validate checksums and the PGP attestation, then we can close this item or request followups. If anything is missing I will raise a scoped request.

anu_sec: Noted. We'll also include a short mapping document that ties each artifact to SOC2 control identifiers (CC6.2, CC7.1, etc.) so you can map evidence quickly.

luis_ops: presigned links posted: 
- s3://pre-sign/redwood-audit/4305550199/rbac-diff.tar.gz -> https://presigned.example/abcd1234 (expires in 7 days)
- s3://pre-sign/redwood-audit/4305550199/kms-cloudtrail-slice.json.gz -> https://presigned.example/efgh5678 (expires in 7 days)
- s3://pre-sign/redwood-audit/4305550199/deploy-trace.json -> https://presigned.example/ijkl9012 (expires in 7 days)

sam_b: Checksums: rbac-diff.tar.gz sha256=6f2c9a...; kms-cloudtrail-slice.json.gz sha256=2a7b1d...; deploy-trace.json sha256=9d0f4e...

anu_sec: PGP attestation uploaded to the bundle (signed by anu_sec@redwood).pubkey id: 0xA1B2C3D4

auditor_jane: I pulled the bundle and verified checksums + signature. Mapping doc looks good. One minor ask: can you add a short note listing playbooks you would follow if the ephemeral key failed to rotate? auditor wants to see IR linkage.

sam_b: Sure — adding an incident-runbook pointer: runbooks/ephemeral-kms-failure.md which includes rollback steps, emergency key custody steps, and postmortem tags. Will include excerpt in the bundle.

luis_ops: bundle updated with runbook excerpt and redaction log. Final check: all filenames and checksums match manifest.csv.

auditor_jane: Great — marking resolved for now. If auditor team needs deeper sampling they'll re-open with a focused ask. Thanks team :clap:
